name: live-v13-refusal
objective: v2.3 replan V13 (and plan 07's missing refusal fixture, L4), with the real model reading every turn: the prepared route asks the player to accept a duel, the player refuses twice and negotiates. The refused-route card must appear only after real reads covered both turns and moved no exit; it must state only what the code knows, offer the authored alternate, and offer no 'Generate the road ahead' on an authored exit. Control: a turn that accepts the duel moves the exit, the story transitions, and the card is gone.

send_generate.text: Ser Kael throws his gauntlet at my feet and demands a duel. I leave it lying there. "No. I will not fight you, Kael. Tell me what you actually want."

send_generate.text: I keep my hands away from my sword. "I still refuse. I did not come here to bleed for your pride. Sit with me and talk, or walk away."
